title: Statements and Callbacks for Paloma Business Owners
content:
### Statements

1. The owner of a Paloma Business account may request a statement of balance movements and payouts for any period whose first day is no earlier than the request date less the plan's statement history months, in calendar months (same day of month, falling back to the month's last day), and whose last day is no later than the request date.
2. Statements are free and are emailed to the owner's address on file, including for a closed account within record retention.

### Callbacks

3. A callback may be scheduled for any account not closed: pending KYB, active, past due or suspended, as the account record shows.
4. The callback is due by the request date plus the plan's callback business days, counted in Paloma business days.
5. A plan with a named account manager is called back by the named account manager.

### Dated examples (hypothetical)

| Request | Judgement |
|---|---|
| Statement requested 15 August on a plan with 12 months of history, for 15 August of the previous year to 15 August | Inside the history: the first day is exactly 12 calendar months earlier and the last day is the request date |
| Same request, starting 14 August of the previous year | Starts earlier than the plan's statement history reaches |
| Statement requested 29 February on a plan with 12 months of history | The February 12 calendar months earlier has no 29th: the earliest first day is that month's last day, 28 February |
| Callback requested for an account whose status is closed | Not scheduled: callbacks are for accounts not closed |
| Callback requested on a plan with 2 callback business days | Due by the second Paloma business day after the request date |
